resources.string: Drop a single word, a strange concept, a late-night phrase, or hum a quick melody right beside your lyrics. Everything stays 100% private on your phone.
Set the song\'s vibe at the top and start writing. LyricVault continuously scans your own saved ideas offline — never inventing new lyrics — so your momentum never breaks.
Microphone permission is needed to record melody tiles inside your idea notes.
Catch an idea, record a melody, start a new song, or open the app in one tap
